projects.title: IoT-Based Weather Display Clock & Forecast Alert System
projects.description: Community Engagement Project (S.Y. 2026): Low-cost smart clock that shows live weather and gives timely forecast alerts to communities using ESP8266, DHT11, BMP280, YL-83, MQ135 sensors and buzzer alerts.

projects.title: RF Communication Range Calculator

projects.title: Modulation and Demodulation Simulator
projects.description: Interactive Analog & Digital Communication Signal Simulation System modeling AM (DSB-FC/SC, SSB), FM (Narrowband/Wideband), PM, and Digital Shift Keying (ASK, FSK, BPSK, QPSK) with live time-domain and FFT spectral analysis.

milestones.title: Mathematical Waveform Equations Formulation
milestones.description: AM, FM, PM mathematical expressions and parameter definitions

milestones.title: Time-Domain Waveform & Live FFT Spectrum Visualizer
milestones.description: Real-time oscilloscope plotting and carrier frequency calculation

milestones.title: Demodulation Filters & Noise Injection Module
milestones.description: Envelope detectors, PLL demodulators, and AWGN noise stage

milestones.title: Interactive Web UI & Parameter Control Sliders
milestones.description: Real-time slider tuning for carrier/modulating frequencies and modulation index

feedbacks.message: Great simulation work on the Modulation and Demodulation Simulator! The AM envelope detector, FM PLL demodulator, and live FFT spectrum are accurately modeled. Progress approved at 80% for your upcoming defense.

Excellent work on the RF Communication Range Calculator! The link budget formulas, Fresnel zone clearance calculations, and interactive slider UI are thoroughly developed. Progress approved at 85% for your upcoming defense.
Outstanding progress on the Web-Based Integrated Project Monitoring System! Frontend and backend REST APIs are functioning smoothly. Progress approved at 90% for your class presentation.

Great work on the IoT-Based Weather Display Clock & Forecast Alert System! Local sensing with buzzer alerts is well thought out for community safety. Progress approved at 80% for your upcoming presentation.
Architecture and documentation reviewed. System is ready for live college demonstration.
